0	[Music]	[Música]
1	This week's Parashah, Parashat Balak. This week
2	falls the yahrzeit of Rabbeinu the Holy Or HaChaim.
3	Not many of the great sages of Israel are called by the name
4	"the Holy."
5	The Holy Or HaChaim
6	was a great Kabbalist,
7	and on the other hand he was also an immense Torah genius. He
8	combined Pshat and Kabbalah.
9	Sadly, he passed away at the age of 47. Very young,
10	but in his lifetime he managed to write many, many
11	books.
12	The most famous book is the Holy Or HaChaim
13	on the Torah,
14	but he has other books as well. He has a book called Peri
15	To'ar. Peri To'ar is a large, deep and very powerful book
16	on the laws of forbidden and permitted, Shulchan Arukh,
17	Yoreh De'ah. He has a book, Rishon LeTzion.
18	Rishon LeTzion, on some of the tractates of the Shas, with
19	immense and wonderful analyses.
20	He also has the book Chefetz HaShem, on the tractates of the Shas,
21	on halakhah and on aggadah.
22	Many, many very important books, but
23	the book that all of Israel loves to study from is the Holy Or
24	HaChaim. The Or HaChaim is a book that investigates
25	and expounds from the wording of the verses, to understand also
26	lofty ideas. There is Mussar in this book, and on the other hand there is
27	also in it a great deal of halakhah, a great deal of
28	Torah analysis. A great and sweet book.
29	I heard from my father, my teacher, Maran Rabbeinu Ovadia Yosef, may the memory of
30	the righteous and holy one be a blessing,
31	that any person who suffers from an eye ailment
32	should study the Holy Or HaChaim.
33	Reading the Holy Or HaChaim sanctifies
34	the eyes and also heals them. And Father told me
35	that when he was ill and suffered from eye pain, he studied
36	the Or HaChaim on the Parashah and he became healthy. This is
37	a segulah. That is, the Holy Or HaChaim was entirely
38	holiness, and his books too are full of holiness.
39	By his light we will walk, and his merit will protect us. Amen. So may it be
40	His will.
41	[Applause]
